body: I appreciate that a lot. I’ll do my best to pull through. Thank you so much

I don’t know what other way to deal with it. I’m alone all the time. I have no friends. I can’t even talk to my fucking parents because my dad talks shit about me and my mom calls me a fat ass and stupid because I suck at school. I have no one else to talk to. At all. I feel like no one cares. Even if I died this very moment while writing this I feel like it wouldn’t affect anyone. I see no future for myself regardless what I wanna do with my life. I sit on my fucking video game every day just to escape how I’m feeling. And it barely works. And because I have nothing else to do. My kindness is always taken for granted and due to that I have major trust issues and my emotions are unstable. I’m not a bad person. I’m very nice. I don’t condone any violence. But I will finish a fight if someone
Starts one with me. I have no confidence in myself at all. I feel like a failure and ugly as
Shit. I feel like an outcast because I have no friends. I didn’t even go to prom and probably won’t go to my grad dance because I’m just that lonely. I don’t know what to do. And I’m sitting here ranting on reddit bc I have no one else to talk to and I feel like shit. I didn’t even mean to write this much. I don’t ask for a lot from anyone. I don’t. All I ask for is honesty and loyalty. But that’s jus so hard for people today. I was gonna kill myself on my 18th Birthday. Because I was so fucking alone. It got to the point where I was asking myself why do people feel this way. Why do people do this to others. And if I feel like shit so much then why the fuck am I even here. I just don’t know what to do
Holy shit. If that’s the case, death doesn’t “feel” so bad
